name: Shared Curse
body:
The curse you bear also afflicts your pet.

Prerequisite(s): Oracle’s curse, must have an animal companion, familiar, or eidolon.

Benefit: Your animal companion, familiar, or eidolon gains your oracle curse, suffering all the same effects as you from your curse.
